class
    LIBRARY_SCOPE_PROBE
create
    make
feature {NONE}
    make
        local
            args: ARGUMENTS
            subject: SCOPE_LIBRARY_SUBJECT
            mode: STRING
            exceptions: EXCEPTIONS
        do
            create args
            create subject.make
            if args.argument_count = 1 then
                mode := args.argument (1)
                if mode.same_string ("library_pre") then
                    subject.test_pre (False)
                elseif mode.same_string ("library_internal_pre") then
                    subject.test_internal_pre
                elseif mode.same_string ("library_return_pre") then
                    subject.test_internal_pre
                    subject.test_pre (False)
                elseif mode.same_string ("library_post") then
                    subject.test_post (False)
                elseif mode.same_string ("library_invariant") then
                    subject.test_invariant
                elseif mode.same_string ("root_check") then
                    check scope_root_check: False end
                elseif mode.same_string ("root_post") then
                    test_root_post (False)
                else
                    create exceptions
                    exceptions.die (2)
                end
                io.put_string ("SCOPE_COMPLETED " + mode + "%N")
            else
                create exceptions
                exceptions.die (2)
            end
        end

    test_root_post (expected: BOOLEAN)
        do
        ensure
            scope_root_post: expected
        end
end

"""Run seven bounded library-scope cases against an already-built executable."""
import argparse
import json
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys

parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
parser.add_argument("executable", type=Path)
parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path, required=True)
args = parser.parse_args()
executable = args.executable.resolve()
args.output.unlink(missing_ok=True)
cases = {
    "library_pre": (True, "scope_library_pre"),
    "library_internal_pre": (False, "scope_library_pre"),
    "library_return_pre": (True, "scope_library_pre"),
    "library_post": (False, "scope_library_post"),
    "library_invariant": (False, "scope_library_invariant"),
    "root_check": (True, "scope_root_check"),
    "root_post": (True, "scope_root_post"),
}
rows = []
for mode, (expected, tag) in cases.items():
    result = subprocess.run([str(executable), mode], cwd=executable.parent,
                            stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
                            text=True, timeout=15)
    completed = "SCOPE_COMPLETED " + mode in result.stdout
    detected = result.returncode != 0 and tag in result.stdout and not completed
    valid_result = detected or (result.returncode == 0 and completed)
    row = {"case": mode, "expected_detection": expected,
           "detected": detected, "completed": completed,
           "valid_result": valid_result,
           "matches": valid_result and detected == expected,
           "exit_code": result.returncode, "output": result.stdout}
    rows.append(row)
    print(mode, "PASS" if row["matches"] else "FAIL", flush=True)
report = {"executable": str(executable), "cases": rows,
          "all_match": all(row["matches"] for row in rows)}
args.output.write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
sys.exit(0 if report["all_match"] else 1)

            expect_collecting ("initial", True)
            memory.collection_off
            expect_collecting ("off", False)
            memory.collection_off
            expect_collecting ("off_again", False)
            memory.collection_on
            expect_collecting ("on", True)
            memory.collection_on
            expect_collecting ("on_again", True)
            memory.collection_off
            expect_collecting ("off_after_on", False)
            memory.collection_on
            expect_collecting ("restored", True)
            io.put_string ("GC_LIFECYCLE_PASSED%N")
        end

    expect_collecting (a_step: STRING; expected: BOOLEAN)
        local
            actual: BOOLEAN
            exceptions: EXCEPTIONS
        do
            actual := memory.collecting
            io.put_string ("GC_STATE " + a_step + " ")
            io.put_boolean (actual)
            io.put_new_line
            if actual /= expected then
                io.error.put_string ("GC_STATE_MISMATCH " + a_step + "%N")
                create exceptions
                exceptions.die (3)
            end
        end
end

"""Bounded runtime qualification of library scope and Boehm GC state changes."""
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import platform
import shutil
import sys
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
REPO = ROOT.parents[1]
OUT = ROOT / "linux-runtime"
OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
REPORT = OUT / "results.json"
REPORT.unlink(missing_ok=True)
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("assertion_probe", REPO / "tools/compiler_assertions/run_probe.py")
probe = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(probe)
environment = {key: value for key, value in os.environ.items()
               if not key.startswith(("GOBO_CLI_", "GOBO_DEFAULT_"))}
for key in ("LD_LIBRARY_PATH", "LD_PRELOAD", "LIBRARY_PATH", "CPATH", "C_INCLUDE_PATH",
            "CPLUS_INCLUDE_PATH", "BOEHM_GC"):
    environment.pop(key, None)
environment.update(GOBO_CC="gcc", GOBO_EIFFEL="ge", LC_ALL="C")
commands = []

def checked(command, directory, log, timeout=300):
    commands.append({"argv": [str(x) for x in command], "cwd": str(directory), "log": str(log)})
    result = probe.run(command, directory, environment, log, timeout)
    if result.returncode:
        raise RuntimeError("Command failed; see " + str(log))
    return result.stdout

def build(name, config):
    directory = OUT / name
    directory.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    ecf = directory / "probe.ecf"
    ecf.write_text(config, encoding="utf-8")
    code = directory / ".gobo"
    executable = code / name
    script = code / (name + ".sh")
    executable.unlink(missing_ok=True)
    script.unlink(missing_ok=True)
    checked(["gec", "--finalize", "--gc=boehm", "--cc=no", ecf], directory, directory / "eiffel.log")
    if not script.exists():
        raise RuntimeError("Fresh C build script missing")
    checked(["sh", "-e", script], code, directory / "c.log")
    with executable.open("rb") as stream:
        if stream.read(4) != b"\x7fELF":
            raise RuntimeError("Expected native Linux executable")
    return executable, directory

if not sys.platform.startswith("linux"):
    raise RuntimeError("Use configured Linux Python")
ns = "{" + probe.NAMESPACE + "}"
ET.register_namespace("", probe.NAMESPACE)
fixture = ROOT / "library-scope"
document = ET.parse(fixture / "probe.ecf").getroot()
target = document.find(ns + "target")
target.find(ns + "cluster").set("location", str(fixture / "app"))
for library in target.findall(ns + "library"):
    if library.get("name") == "scope_library":
        library.set("location", str(fixture / "scope_library.ecf"))
version = checked(["gec", "--version"], OUT, OUT / "version.log").strip()
gcc = checked(["gcc", "--version"], OUT, OUT / "gcc.log").splitlines()[0]
scope_exe, scope_dir = build("library_scope_probe", ET.tostring(document, encoding="unicode"))
checked([sys.executable, fixture / "check_cases.py", scope_exe,
         "--output", scope_dir / "scope-results.json"], scope_dir, scope_dir / "cases.log")
scope = json.loads((scope_dir / "scope-results.json").read_text())
print("Library scope:", len(scope["cases"]), "passed", flush=True)

gc_source = ROOT / "windows/gc-source/gc_probe.e"
document = ET.parse(ROOT / "windows/memory-lifecycle/probe.ecf").getroot()
document.find(ns + "target").find(ns + "cluster").set("location", str(gc_source.parent))
gc_exe, gc_dir = build("gc_probe", ET.tostring(document, encoding="unicode"))
gc_output = checked([gc_exe], gc_dir, gc_dir / "cases.log", 15)
gc_states = [line for line in gc_output.splitlines() if line.startswith("GC_STATE ")]
expected_states = ["GC_STATE initial True", "GC_STATE off False", "GC_STATE off_again False",
                   "GC_STATE on True", "GC_STATE on_again True", "GC_STATE off_after_on False",
                   "GC_STATE restored True"]
gc_passed = gc_states == expected_states and "GC_LIFECYCLE_PASSED" in gc_output
if not gc_passed:
    raise RuntimeError("GC lifecycle output mismatch")
print("GC lifecycle: 7 states passed", flush=True)
sources = [fixture / "app/library_scope_probe.e", fixture / "library/scope_library_subject.e",
           fixture / "probe.ecf", fixture / "scope_library.ecf", fixture / "check_cases.py", gc_source]
report = {"platform": platform.platform(), "compiler": {"path": shutil.which("gec"), "version": version},
          "gcc": gcc, "commands": commands,
          "sources_sha256": {str(path.relative_to(ROOT)): hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for path in sources},
          "executable_sha256": {str(path.relative_to(ROOT)): hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for path in (scope_exe, gc_exe)},
          "scope": scope, "gc": {"states": gc_states, "output": gc_output, "passed": gc_passed},
          "all_passed": scope["all_match"] and gc_passed}
staging = REPORT.with_suffix(".staging")
staging.write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
staging.replace(REPORT)
print("Evidence:", REPORT)

import importlib.util
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import platform
import subprocess
import sys
import time
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
REPO = ROOT.parents[2]
source = REPO / 'tools/compiler_assertions/run_probe.py'
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('probe_config', source)
probe = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(probe)
ENV = {key: value for key, value in os.environ.items()
       if not key.startswith(('GOBO_CLI_', 'GOBO_DEFAULT_'))}
for key in ('BOEHM_GC', 'LIBRARY_PATH', 'CPATH', 'C_INCLUDE_PATH', 'CPLUS_INCLUDE_PATH'):
    ENV.pop(key, None)
ENV.update(GOBO='C:/gobo', GOBO_EIFFEL='ge', GOBO_CC='zig', ISE_PLATFORM='win64',
           ZIG_GLOBAL_CACHE_DIR=str(ROOT/'zig-global-cache'),
           ZIG_LOCAL_CACHE_DIR=str(ROOT/'zig-local-cache'))
ENV['PATH'] = r'C:\gobo\bin;' + ENV.get('PATH', '')
COMPILER = Path('C:/gobo/bin/gec.exe')

def run(command, cwd, log, timeout=240):
    command = [str(part) for part in command]
    with subprocess.Popen(command, cwd=cwd, env=ENV, stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
                          stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, text=True,
                          creationflags=subprocess.CREATE_NO_WINDOW) as process:
        try:
            output, _ = process.communicate(timeout=timeout)
        except BaseException:
            subprocess.run(['taskkill', '/PID', str(process.pid), '/T', '/F'],
                           stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
                           creationflags=subprocess.CREATE_NO_WINDOW)
            output, _ = process.communicate()
            log.write_text(output, encoding='utf-8')
            raise
    log.write_text(output, encoding='utf-8')
    return subprocess.CompletedProcess(command, process.returncode, output)

def checked(command, cwd, log):
    result = run(command, cwd, log)
    if result.returncode:
        raise RuntimeError('Failed {}: {}\n{}'.format(result.returncode, command, result.stdout[-5000:]))
    return result.stdout.strip()

def build(directory, config, system='assertion_probe'):
    directory.mkdir(exist_ok=True, parents=True)
    config_path = directory/'probe.ecf'
    config_path.write_text(config, encoding='utf-8')
    code = directory/'.gobo'
    executable = code/(system+'.exe')
    script = code/(system+'.bat')
    for path in (executable, script, directory/(system+'.exe'), directory/(system+'.bat')):
        if path.exists():
            path.unlink()
    print('Building '+directory.name, flush=True)
    try:
        checked([COMPILER, '--finalize', '--gc=boehm', '--cc=no', config_path], directory, directory/'eiffel.log')
        if not script.is_file():
            raise RuntimeError('Missing fresh generated batch script '+str(script))
        checked(['cmd.exe', '/d', '/c', script], code, directory/'c.log')
        if executable.read_bytes()[:2] != b'MZ':
            raise RuntimeError('Expected native Windows executable '+str(executable))
    except BaseException:
        if executable.exists():
            executable.unlink()
        raise
    return executable

def gc_config():
    document = ET.fromstring(probe.config_text('Gobo', 'all_on'))
    ns = '{'+probe.NAMESPACE+'}'
    document.set('name', 'gc_probe')
    target = document.find(ns+'target')
    target.set('name', 'gc_probe')
    target.find(ns+'root').set('class', 'GC_PROBE')
    target.find(ns+'cluster').set('location', (ROOT/'gc-source').as_posix())
    return ET.tostring(document, encoding='unicode')

def main():
    result_path = ROOT/'results.json'
    result_path.unlink(missing_ok=True)
    results = {
        'platform': platform.platform(), 'compiler': str(COMPILER),
        'version': checked([COMPILER, '--version'], ROOT, ROOT/'version.log'),
        'backend': 'bundled Zig, native Windows', 'gc': 'boehm',
        'source_sha256': {p.name:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in probe.SOURCE.glob('*.e')},
        'cases': [],
    }
    for selection in ('all_on', 'all_off', 'supplier_only'):
        directory = ROOT/selection
        executable = build(directory, probe.config_text('Gobo', selection))
        for mode, tag in probe.TAGS.items():
            result = run([executable, mode], directory, directory/(mode+'.log'), timeout=30)
            completed = 'PROBE_COMPLETED '+mode in result.stdout
            detected = result.returncode != 0 and tag in result.stdout and not completed
            if not detected and not (result.returncode == 0 and completed):
                raise RuntimeError('Unrelated probe failure: {} {}\n{}'.format(selection,mode,result.stdout))
            expected = selection == 'all_on' or (selection == 'supplier_only' and mode == 'pre')
            row = dict(selection=selection, assertion=mode, expected_violation=expected,
                       detected_violation=detected, matches_requested_setting=detected==expected,
                       exit_code=result.returncode, diagnostic=result.stdout)
            results['cases'].append(row)
            print(json.dumps({k:v for k,v in row.items() if k!='diagnostic'}), flush=True)
    gc_directory = ROOT/'memory-lifecycle'
    gc_binary = build(gc_directory, gc_config(), 'gc_probe')
    gc_result = run([gc_binary], gc_directory, gc_directory/'lifecycle.log', timeout=30)
    results['memory_lifecycle'] = dict(exit_code=gc_result.returncode, output=gc_result.stdout,
                                     passed=gc_result.returncode==0 and 'GC_LIFECYCLE_PASSED' in gc_result.stdout)
    if not results['memory_lifecycle']['passed']:
        raise RuntimeError('GC lifecycle failed\n'+gc_result.stdout)
    results['all_requested_checks_match'] = all(r['matches_requested_setting'] for r in results['cases'])
    result_path.write_text(json.dumps(results, indent=2)+'\n', encoding='utf-8')
    print('Published '+str(result_path), flush=True)

if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
